title: Tree Folding
statementMd:
Vanya wants to minimize a tree. He can perform the following operation multiple times: choose a vertex $*v*$, and two disjoint (except for $*v*$) paths of equal length $*a*_{0} = *v*$, $*a*_{1}$, ..., $*a*_{*k*}$, and $*b*_{0} = *v*$, $*b*_{1}$, ..., $*b*_{*k*}$. Additionally, vertices $*a*_{1}$, ..., $*a*_{*k*}$, $*b*_{1}$, ..., $*b*_{*k*}$ must not have any neighbours in the tree other than adjacent vertices of corresponding paths. After that, one of the paths may be merged into the other, that is, the vertices $*b*_{1}$, ..., $*b*_{*k*}$ can be effectively erased:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/36f4cfaafeb06f77c5d15bcceef352da0b3b30ba.png)

Help Vanya determine if it possible to make the tree into a path via a sequence of described operations, and if the answer is positive, also determine the shortest length of such path.

## Input

The first line of input contains the number of vertices $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$).

Next $*n* - 1$ lines describe edges of the tree. Each of these lines contains two space-separated integers $*u*$ and $*v*$ ($1 ≤ *u*, *v* ≤ *n*$, $*u* ≠ *v*$) — indices of endpoints of the corresponding edge. It is guaranteed that the given graph is a tree.

## Output

If it is impossible to obtain a path, print `-1`. Otherwise, print the minimum number of edges in a possible path.

## Note

In the first sample case, a path of three edges is obtained after merging paths $2 - 1 - 6$ and $2 - 4 - 5$.

It is impossible to perform any operation in the second sample case. For example, it is impossible to merge paths $1 - 3 - 4$ and $1 - 5 - 6$, since vertex 6 additionally has a neighbour 7 that is not present in the corresponding path.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
Vanya 想要将一棵树最小化。他可以多次执行以下操作：选择一个顶点 $*v*$，以及两条除 $*v*$ 外不相交、长度均为 $*a*_{0} = *v*$、$*a*_{1}$、...、$*a*_{*k*}$ 和 $*b*_{0} = *v*$、$*b*_{1}$、...、$*b*_{*k*}$ 的路径。此外，顶点 $*a*_{1}$、...、$*a*_{*k*}$、$*b*_{1}$、...、$*b*_{*k*}$ 在树中不能有对应路径上相邻顶点以外的任何邻居。之后，可以将其中一条路径合并到另一条路径中，也就是说，顶点 $*b*_{1}$、...、$*b*_{*k*}$ 可以被有效地删除：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/36f4cfaafeb06f77c5d15bcceef352da0b3b30ba.png)

请帮助 Vanya 判断能否通过一系列上述操作将这棵树变成一条路径；如果可以，还请确定这条路径的最短长度。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含顶点数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$）。

接下来的 $*n*$ - 1 行描述树的边。每行包含两个以空格分隔的整数 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$（$1 ≤ *u*, *v* ≤ *n*$，$*u* ≠ *v*$），表示对应边的两个端点的编号。保证给出的图是一棵树。

## 输出格式

如果无法得到一条路径，输出 `-1`。否则，输出可能得到的路径的最小边数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，合并路径 $2 - 1 - 6$ 和 $2 - 4 - 5$ 后，可以得到一条包含 3 条边的路径。

在第二个样例中，无法执行任何操作。例如，无法合并路径 $1 - 3 - 4$ 和 $1 - 5 - 6$，因为顶点 6 还额外连接着不在对应路径中的顶点 7。
</statement>
